en.title: ACME Kids Peel-and-Stick Ocean Wall Decals (36 pc)
en.short_description: 36 removable ocean stickers, matte finish, repositionable without damaging paint.
en.long_description: Thirty-six matte decals: a whale, dolphins, sea turtles, seahorses, and drifts of fish, plus coral and bubbles to scatter between them. Each one repositions without lifting paint, so the reef can be rebuilt whenever inspiration strikes.
review_snippets: Went up in twenty minutes and came off our rental walls clean
The big whale over the bed is the star of the room
Went up bubble-free — our kid handled half the wall solo

zh.title: ACME 儿童即撕即贴海洋墙贴（36件）
zh.short_description: 36张可移除海洋贴纸,哑光饰面,可重新放置而不损坏漆面。
zh.long_description: 三十六张哑光贴纸：一只鲸鱼、海豚、海龟、海马和成群的鱼，外加珊瑚和气泡散布其间。每张都可重新放置而不损伤漆面，因此无论何时灵感涌现，都能重建这片礁石。
review_snippets: 二十分钟就贴好了，从我们租的房子墙上撕下来干干净净
床上方的大鲸鱼是整个房间的亮点
贴上去没有气泡——我们家孩子一个人贴了半面墙
